Fixture for test/check-default-columns.test.mjs. Text before the first section
header is ignored by the parser.

Provenance (real API output only; nothing here is hand-written):
- Every section except the last two: scripts/probe-api-spec.sh, run once on
  2026-10-16 (24 probes, all HTTP 200), trimmed to the COLUMNS sections the
  checker maps plus one CRITERIA section.
- "Contracts_OGE FY" and "Contracts_NYCHA no FY": the live API's error text
  quoted in issue #40 (2026-10-15), from search_nycedc_contracts with
  fiscal_year=2025 and search_nycha_contracts with vendor_name only. Those are
  the exact call shapes the two new probe variants send.

This is a snapshot, not a live oracle. It goes stale whenever Checkbook changes.
Variants the probe gained after 2026-10-16 (Contracts FY, pending FY, Spending
issue_date, Budget year, Payroll calendar_year) are deliberately absent.

===== Contracts registered/expense :: COLUMNS =====
Provided response column 'zzz_invalid' value is not allowed for 'Registered Contracts(expense) All Years' domain. Valid values are 'contract_class,contract_includes_sub_vendors,mocs_registered,document_code,parent_contract_id,prime_contract_apt_pin,percent_covid_spending,percent_other_spending,prime_contract_award_method,prime_contract_current_amount,prime_contract_end_date,prime_contract_expense_category,prime_contract_id,prime_contract_industry,prime_contract_original_amount,prime_contract_pin,prime_contract_purpose,prime_contract_registration_date,prime_contract_start_date,prime_contract_type,prime_oca_number,prime_contract_version,prime_contracting_agency,prime_vendor,prime_vendor_mwbe_category,prime_vendor_spent_to_date,prime_woman_owned_business,prime_emerging_business,sub_contract_current_amount,sub_contract_end_date,sub_contract_industry,sub_contract_original_amount,sub_contract_purpose,sub_contract_reference_id,sub_contract_start_date,sub_vendor,sub_vendor_mwbe_category,sub_vendor_paid_to_date,sub_contract_status,sub_woman_owned_business,sub_emerging_business,vendor_record_type'.
